articles.summary: Pandora A/S reported Q3 2026 sales of DKK 6,694 million and net income of DKK 517 million, with basic EPS from continuing operations at DKK 6.9. articles.title: Pandora shares jump 7% as Q3 sales beat, tariff refund boosts profit
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Shares in Danish jeweller Pandora jumped more than 7% on Wednesday after third-quarter like-for-like sales growth beat even the highest analyst estimate, although a one-off U.S. tariff refund accounted for more than the operating profit beat and sales growth slowed to 1% in October.

articles.title: Pandora shares rise as jeweller plans shift to platinum amid silver challenges
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Pandora A/S (CSE:PNDORA)) shares rose 3.2% on Thursday after the world’s largest jewellery brand announced plans to transition from silver to platinum-plated jewellery, despite delivering lower-than-expected 2025 results and issuing cautious guidance for 2026.
